description: Ordered rules that decide what a BOM line is. First matching keyword rule wins, then item-number prefix rules, then the quantity default. Patterns are phrase-level on purpose: a single word such as INSERT, INK or BOX must not remove a physical kit component from the comparison. Edit to suit the site; the reason string is reported with every categorisation.

keyword_rules.reason: description identifies a measuring tape, including JDE's MEASUARING spelling; a PK prefix does not make it packaging
description identifies a sterile barrier wrap or packaging bag

item prefix FM denotes a form/record
